unsupported: Watson Furniture traces its roots to 1966 when South African-born cabinetmaker and metalworker Grahame Watson opened a small workshop on Bainbridge Island, Washington.

The company relocated to a 34-acre manufacturing campus in nearby Poulsbo and has remained family-owned since 2010, when Clif and Kathy McKenzie assumed majority ownership after a 1989 partnership with Bill Haggerty and Daniel Warn.
The Poulsbo facility handles all fabrication, finishing, and assembly in-house.

Known for: Family-owned, Poulsbo-based, fiercely independent; 34-acre in-house manufacturing campus; PFAS-free, heat-cured electrostatically applied coating; Standard finishes guaranteed to ship next business day
